title: Manager, Solutions Consultants, UKI
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Notion
description_html:
Who We Are

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.

Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.

About the Role:

The Solutions Consultant Manager is the person who makes our GTM motion real on the ground. As an in-region leader directly managing a team of Solutions Consultants, you'll own your team's full commercial output—new logo, expansion, and renewals—and be accountable for both the results and the quality of execution that produces them.

This isn't a traditional pipeline-management role. The best SC Managers are coaches first: they know what a great first meeting looks like, can watch a live build and tell a rep exactly what to change, and build the operating rhythm and inspection cadence that makes consistent execution possible across the team. If you're a builder who loves developing people as much as winning deals—and you want to lead a regional team in a go-to-market model that's genuinely new—this is the role.

This role will be based in London, UK. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days.

What You'll Achieve:

  • Own the commercial performance of your team across new logo ARR, expansion ARR, and UBP outcomes—accountable for both the headline numbers and the quality of execution that drives them

  • Coach SCs on the GTM builder motion: what great looks like in a first meeting (workflow diagnosis, current → future architecture), a second meeting (live build in Notion + value narrative), and through the full cycle to adoption hand-off

  • Contribute to and participate in the regional operating cadence: weekly pipeline reviews, deal support sessions, call reviews against the motion quality rubric, and forecast calls with senior leadership

  • Hire, onboard, and certify new SCs to the GTM builder motion—driving readiness from ramp through consistent execution, and managing performance with clarity when expectations aren't met

  • Partner with the regional BDR manager on pipeline strategy, outbound targeting, and qualification standards to ensure the team's book of business is healthy and growing

  • Partner with Outcomes leadership on adoption hand-offs, at-risk account management, and renewal strategy—owning the overall commercial arc for the region while collaborating on the execution that follows close

  • Represent your team or region in leadership forums with clear signal on what's working, what needs investment, and where execution is breaking down

Skills You'll Need to Bring:

  • Track record as a quota-carrying B2B seller with direct experience in workflow design, live demos, or technical sales—you can coach the builder motion because you've run it yourself

  • Frontline sales management experience: built an operating cadence, ran performance management, and developed talent from onboarding through consistent overperformance

  • Strong coaching orientation: you can watch a demo or deal review and identify specifically what to change—not just whether the outcome was good, but why, and what the rep should do differently next time

  • Commercial instincts at the team level: able to read pipeline health, identify risk early, and drive urgency across a team without micromanaging individual deals

  • You don't need to be an AI expert, but you're curious and willing to adopt AI tools to work smarter and deliver better results.

Nice to Haves:

  • Experience selling or managing in a consumption or usage-based business where adoption signals matter as much as closed ARR

  • Track record building high-performing regional teams from an early stage: hiring to profile, structured onboarding, certification, and performance management

Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role's scope and complexity, and the candidate's experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. The estimated range for total on target earnings (including base salary and on target incentive pay) for this role is £294,000 per year.

By clicking “Submit Application”, I understand and agree that Notion and its affiliates and subsidiaries will collect and process my information in accordance with Notion’s Global Recruiting Privacy Policy.

#LI-Onsite

A Note on AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.

Equal Opportunity & Accommodations

We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. Notion is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristic. Consistent with applicable law, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Notion provides reasonable accommodations during the application process; if you need one, please let your recruiter know.

Notion is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. Notion considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Notion is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please let your recruiter know.

title: Business Development Representative, EMEA - UK
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Menlosecurity
description_html:
Menlo Security is the leader in Browser Security for human and agentic workforces. Our mission is to enable humans and agents to connect, communicate, and collaborate securely, without compromise. The Menlo Browser Security Platform protects organizations from cyberattacks by stopping threats across the web, documents, and email before they reach the user. With Menlo Agent Runtime Security (MARS), that protection now extends to the AI agents working alongside every employee. Menlo Security is trusted by major global businesses, including Fortune 500 companies and government agencies, to protect their most valuable asset, their data, and is backed by top-tier investors.

Summary

The Senior Business Development Representative, EMEA is on the front line with prospects, partners, and customers, generating qualified pipeline across enterprise accounts throughout Europe, the Middle East, and Africa. Based in the UK, the person in this role works across multiple countries, languages, and buying cultures, partnering closely with Field Sales and Menlo's EMEA channel ecosystem of distributors, resellers, and global system integrators to open doors into some of the most security-conscious organizations in the region. As a senior member of the team, they take on the most complex target accounts, help shape the outbound playbooks the wider BDR team runs on, and support newer teammates as they ramp. They use AI tools daily for account research, call preparation, and outreach drafting, so more of their time goes to real conversations with prospects and less to administrative work.

Outcomes & KPIs

(Metrics below are drafted suggestions for the hiring manager to confirm or adjust.)

Key Outcome(s) Owned:

  • A consistent, growing flow of qualified EMEA enterprise pipeline for the field sales team.

  • Deep, well-nurtured engagement across the assigned EMEA target account list, in partnership with Field Sales and channel partners.

Success Metrics / KPIs:

  • Qualified meetings booked and held per month.

  • Pipeline value sourced per quarter (in local currency and USD equivalent).

  • Lead-to-opportunity conversion rate in Salesforce.

  • Engagement coverage across Target Account Program accounts in the assigned EMEA territory.

  • Prospect attendance sourced for targeted Menlo field events and regional trade shows.

  • Contribution to team ramp: outbound sequences, messaging, or call approaches adopted by other BDRs.

What You'll Do

  • Prospect into EMEA enterprise accounts through cold calling and multi-channel outreach, qualify leads, and schedule meetings between qualified prospects and the sales team.

  • Own the most complex accounts in the territory, adapting outreach to the buying culture, language, and regulatory environment of each country you cover.

  • Use AI tools to research accounts, prepare for calls, and draft tailored outbound messaging, applying your own judgment for accuracy, tone, and regional context.

  • Deliver Menlo's pitch and technology story, tailoring it to the specific needs of each prospect and answering questions clearly.

  • Manage and nurture leads end to end in Salesforce, including tracking, follow-up, and conversion, using AI-generated call summaries and CRM enrichment to reduce administrative time.

  • Work with EMEA distributors, resellers, and system integrators, alongside Field Sales, to grow Target Account Program accounts and continuously nurture them.

  • Share what works: contribute proven sequences, messaging, and call approaches back to the BDR team, and support newer teammates as they ramp.

  • Invite and schedule prospects for targeted Menlo field events across the region; some travel will be required.

Functional Competencies

Required:

  • 3+ years of business development or sales development experience within the IT industry and/or selling cybersecurity or SaaS products, with a proven track record in cold calling. [Confirm against S5 leveling with comp before posting.]

  • Professional fluency in English, both written and spoken.

  • Experience prospecting across multiple countries or markets, not a single-country patch.

  • Ability to understand technical information and explain it in simple, clear terms.

  • Proficiency with Salesforce for tracking meetings, opportunities, and prospect details.

  • Strong organization and time management skills.

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience.

  • Existing right to work in the United Kingdom.

  • Willingness to travel occasionally within EMEA.

Preferred / Nice to Have:

  • Cybersecurity industry background.

  • Additional language skills relevant to the region, particularly German or Arabic.

  • Familiarity with EMEA data protection and residency expectations (GDPR, UK GDPR) and how they shape security buying conversations.

  • Experience with prospecting and marketing automation tools such as Outreach.io, ZoomInfo, or LinkedIn Sales Navigator.

  • Experience using AI sales tools for account research, outreach personalization, or call summarization.

  • Knowledge of sales and marketing principles and strategies.

  • Experience working with distributors and resellers in a two-tier EMEA channel model.

  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office and Google Workspace.

  • Experience thriving in a fast-paced, high-growth environment with constant learning.

Follow us on LinkedIn!

Why Menlo?

At Menlo, we don't settle for the status quo — in our technology or our culture. How we think and act is just as important as what we build. Our culture is defined by five core mindsets: Proactive Leadership, Straight Talk, United Impact, Elevated Talent, and Customer-Compelled. We take ownership and drive outcomes without waiting to be told. We communicate directly and seek hard truths. We break down silos and win together. We hold a high bar for ourselves and the people around us. And we treat every customer interaction as mission-critical. If you're someone who sees it, owns it, solves it, and does it — you'll thrive here.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, sex, color, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, or on the basis of disability.

TO ALL AGENCIES: Please, no phone calls or emails to any employee of Menlo Security outside of the Talent organization. Menlo Security’s policy is to only accept resumes from agencies via Ashby (ATS). Agencies must have a valid services agreement executed and must have been assigned by the Talent team to a specific requisition. Any resume submitted outside of this process will be deemed the sole property of Menlo Security. In the event a candidate submitted outside of this policy is hired, no fee or payment will be paid.

title: International Data Acquisition Manager
salary_basis: Based on historical internship stipend records at Socure
description_html:
Why Socure?

Socure is building the identity trust infrastructure for the digital economy — verifying 100% of good identities in real time and stopping fraud before it starts. The mission is big, the problems are complex, and the impact is felt by businesses, governments, and millions of people every day.

We hire people who want that level of responsibility. People who move fast, think critically, act like owners, and care deeply about solving customer problems with precision. If you want predictability or narrow scope, this won’t be your place. If you want to help build the future of identity with a team that holds a high bar for itself — keep reading.

As an International Data Acquisition Manager at Socure, you will be instrumental in expanding and managing our global data assets to power Socure’s identity verification, fraud prevention, and compliance solutions. Your primary focus will be sourcing, evaluating, onboarding, and managing third-party data providers across international markets, with a strong emphasis on data quality, operational scalability, and regulatory compliance.

 

Reporting to the Head of Data Acquisition and Strategy, you will collaborate closely with the Product, Data Science, Engineering, Legal, Compliance, and external data partners. Together, you will identify and operationalize data sources to enhance product performance, broaden geographic reach, and drive Socure’s international growth.

 

This role is especially critical as Socure deepens its international investments, building in-region capabilities and expanding its product support in the EU, UK, LATAM, and other key markets.

 

What You'll Do

Vendor and Data Management

  • Support the evaluation, onboarding, and ongoing management of third-party data vendors across multiple international markets and product lines, ensuring alignment with business priorities and needs.

  • Assist in preparing RFIs, RFPs, diligence materials, and vendor assessments to evaluate provider capabilities, data quality, compliance posture, operational fit, and commercial value.

  • Maintain clear, auditable documentation regarding purchased data, vendor status, usage rights, contractual constraints, and performance across the data acquisition lifecycle.

  • Help manage renewals and identify new vendors to improve product quality, expand coverage, and enhance cost efficiency.

 

Collaboration and Internationalization Strategy

  • Research and evaluate new international data sources aligned with Socure’s strategic priorities, particularly for identity verification, fraud prevention, KYC/eKYC, Document Verification, and compliance use cases.

  • Develop a deep understanding of Socure products and international scenarios to assess the relevance, incremental value, and risks of potential data sources.

  • Partner with Product, Data Science, Engineering, Legal, Compliance, and Procurement to align on priorities, plan integrations, and ensure effective operationalization of new data sources.

  • Contribute to data acquisition that promotes inclusivity, coverage, and fairness in identity verification across diverse populations and regions.

  • Represent the Data Acquisition team in cross-functional meetings, clearly communicating findings, trade-offs, and recommendations to technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Data Quality and Integration

  • Assist in due diligence for prospective data sources, including data quality assessments, overlap and coverage analysis, compliance reviews, and performance testing.

  • Support structured evaluations and proof-of-concept testing for new vendors and datasets using evidence-based methods to determine business value and product impact.

  • Monitor and report on data quality metrics, vendor performance, feed reliability, and issues such as drift, schema changes, or outages; help coordinate remediation as necessary.

  • Work with internal technical teams to plan integrations, including understanding schemas, APIs, delivery models, and operational dependencies.

Operational Excellence

  • Manage day-to-day operations across the international data acquisition lifecycle, including vendor communications, issue resolution, documentation, and follow-up on action items.

  • Track and document cost, usage, and value metrics for acquired datasets, supporting budgeting, renewals, prioritization, and vendor decisions.

  • Identify opportunities to streamline processes, improve evaluation frameworks, and scale the team’s operating model as international data needs expand.

What You Bring

  • 5+ years of experience in data acquisition, vendor management, procurement, partnerships, data operations, or a related field.

  • Experience evaluating or managing third-party data providers, ideally across multiple markets or jurisdictions.

  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to assess data quality, business value, and operational trade-offs.

  • Working knowledge of regulatory and privacy frameworks impacting data acquisition and usage, including UK GDPR, EU GDPR, and other relevant data protection requirements.

  • Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail, including experience maintaining structured documentation and evaluation records.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to collaborate across technical and non-technical teams.

  • Ability to manage shifting priorities and work effectively in a fast-paced, cross-functional environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working with data vendors in identity verification, fraud prevention, financial services, regtech, or compliance-related markets.

  • Familiarity with international identity, KYC/eKYC, or watchlist-related data ecosystems.

  • Knowledge of global data landscapes, including government, credit bureau, mobile network, utility, electoral, or equivalent data sources used in various countries.

  • Familiarity with data integration concepts, including APIs, batch delivery, schemas, and operationalizing external data feeds.

  • Experience using SQL or similar tools for data analysis, profiling, or evaluation.

  • Experience working with UK and European market data providers or supporting products in the UK and internationally.

 

Socure is an equal opportunity employer that values diversity in all its forms within our company. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.
If you need an accommodation during any stage of the application or hiring process—including interview or onboarding support—please reach out to your Socure recruiting partner directly.

description_html:
Why join us?

Mitti by SafetyCulture is a global tech company, just not the kind you're picturing. Our almost 1,000-person team builds tools that make work better for the three billion frontline workers who keep the world moving. We've got big tech scale, without the sign-off layers or corporate theatre. Every permanent team member gets equity, so when we grow, you do too. This next chapter is about scaling smart, powered by AI, a clear vision and real ownership.

Big tech impact, without the big tech ick.


The role:
We're after someone ready to lead people. You'll take on a team of Account Executives focused on growing revenue across our existing customer base, hunting for expansion into new teams and business units within accounts we already serve, taking on new accounts within the base and growing them, and driving renewals.

The focus is growing and protecting the revenue we already have, not new-logo acquisition. You'll get support and a proven playbook while you build the day-to-day craft of leading a team: running a rhythm, coaching a rep through a stuck deal, and holding people to a number.

 

What you'll be doing:

  • Lead & Coach: Onboard and develop your team of Account Executives. Get hands-on in discovery, solution selling, negotiation, and closing.

  • Drive Performance: Own team quota, pipeline coverage, and activity. Hold the team to clear expectations and a consistent rhythm.

  • Operational Excellence: Own pipeline and forecasting accuracy for your patch. Use the data to see where reps are stuck and where the best expansion opportunities are.

  • Process Discipline: Help the team use our core methodologies (MEDDPICC and SPICE) day-to-day, not just in theory.

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work with Marketing, Business Development, Solutions Consulting, and Customer Success to move deals forward and grow value in existing accounts.

  • Culture Carrier: Build a team that has each other's back, holds a high bar, and still has fun doing it.

 

About you:

  • A natural people leader: someone others already turn to for guidance, direction, and coaching.

  • Prior experience in a people leadership role for a full team of Account Executives

  • Good coaching instincts: you can spot when someone's stuck and tell them plainly, but kindly, what to do differently.

  • A solid grounding in modern SaaS sales methodology (MEDDPICC, SPICE, or similar).

  • Comfortable with data: pipeline, forecasting, and using the numbers to decide where to spend your time.

  • You're fine with a fast-paced environment where priorities shift and the goalposts move.

  • A natural motivator who leads with empathy, clarity, and accountability.

  • You use AI in your day-to-day work and are happy to help your team pick up the same habits.


At Mitti, we care about people and growing the team, through:

  • Equity with high growth potential, and a competitive salary,

  • Hybrid working arrangements with flexibility,

  • Access to professional and personal training and development opportunities; Hackathons, Workshops, Lunch & Learns;

  • We encourage involvement in the community, open source work, attending talks and events, and experimenting with new technologies.

You'll also receive other perks such as:

  • In-house Culinary Crew serving up daily breakfast, lunch and snacks

  • Wellbeing initiatives such as subsidised fitness programs, EAP services and generous parental leave policy

  • Quarterly celebrations and team events

  • Table tennis, board games, gym sessions, book club, and pet-friendly offices.

 

We’re committed to building inclusive teams and cultivating a sense of belonging so our people can bring their whole authentic selves to work each day. We seek to make reasonable adjustments throughout our recruitment process to create an even playing field for all candidates. Thanks to the tireless efforts of the entire Mitti team we’ve built an incredible culture which has seen us recognised as a Best Place to Work in Australia , the US and the UK .

Even if you don't meet every requirement listed in the ad, please consider applying for this role. We prioritise inclusion and value individuals with potential over a checklist of qualifications. Don't rule yourself out, hit that apply button if this job resonates with you

You can find out more about life at Mitti via Youtube , Twitter , Instagram and LinkedIn.

To all recruitment agencies, we do not accept resumes or partnership opportunities. Please do not forward resumes to Mitti or any of our employees. We are not responsible for any fees associated with unsolicited resumes.

title: Principal Software Engineer
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Cytix
description_html:
You’ll be a Technical Leader, unblock the engineering team by resolving complex technical impasses, standardising engineering practices, and owning cross-functional initiatives.

You'll still be a highly hands-on engineer, responsible for rapidly prototyping, shipping MVPs, and turning product ideas into polished user experiences. You’ll work across the stack, collaborating closely with product, design, and engineering teams while operating with a high degree of independence.

 

What you'll do

 

  • Build and ship new product features end-to-end

  • Lead rapid prototyping and MVP development

  • Develop modern frontend applications using TypeScript, Vue 3 Composition API, and Tailwind

  • Contribute to backend services using Node, Bun, Koa, PostgreSQL, Prisma, and AWS

  • Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to shape product direction

  • Improve performance, reliability, and developer experience across the platfor

  • Support on hiring, performance and technical roadmaps.

 

What you'll need

 

  • Extensive experience building modern frontend applications with TypeScript and Vue3

  • Solid backend experience with Node-based services and relational databases

  • Experience working with PostgreSQL, Prisma, AWS, and REST APIs

  • Comfortable moving quickly, making pragmatic decisions, and shipping iteratively

  • Strong communication and collaboration skills

  • Able to work independently in a hybrid environment

  • Ideally have been in early stage start-ups going through growth and technical challenges

 

What you'll get

  • Share options - If Cytix wins, you should too.

  • Unlimited Holidays!

  • Enhanced maternity and paternity pay.

  • Pension - 8% (3% employer, 5% employee)

  • Private Healthcare through Vitality including dental, optical and hearing

  • Work from anywhere (WFA)

  • Celebrate your birthday with a day off work

  • Octopus car scheme - Drive an electric car through salary sacrifice

  • Inclusivity as standard - A team where you can do your best work as yourself, no asterisks.


About Cytix

  • Software never stops changing. Teams ship new code every day, through tickets, pull requests, releases, and increasingly with AI in the mix, but the way security keeps up with all that change hasn't really moved on.

  • That's the problem we're solving. Cytix helps organisations understand which software changes actually matter, what should happen next, and how to prove the right call was made. Security understood, in other words.

    We're a small team with big plans, so every person we hire genuinely shapes what Cytix becomes. That's why we're upfront about our five values: we interview for all of them, and they matter to us more than a perfect CV. They're things you do, not things you are, so have a read and see if they sound like you.

     

    Make the first move. When the goal is clear but the path isn't, you get moving rather than waiting for perfect instructions. If you're blocked, you make a sensible call, say what you're assuming, and explain how you'd course-correct. We'd rather you act and be slightly wrong than sit still.

     

    Find the smarter path. You ask why before how. You dig into what the real problem is instead of just building what the spec says, and you're happy to question 'that's how it's always been done' when the reason behind it has gone stale.

     

    See it through. When something's yours, it lands. No loose ends, no surprises for whoever picks it up next. You keep people posted when things change, and if something falls between roles, you catch it.

     

    Raise the bar. You do the best job possible in the time you've got, whether that's a day or a month. Sometimes that means deep craft; sometimes the smartest move is quick and scrappy. It's about good judgement, and we hold each other to it without blame or politics.

     

    Play to win. You care about the mission but don't take yourself too seriously. You say 'I' when things go wrong and 'we' when they go right, trust teammates to do things their own way, and bring a bit of humour when the pressure's on.

    Sound like you on a normal working day? We'd love to meet you.

Compensation: £100K – £120K • Equity

title: Procurement Manager
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Andercore
description_html:
About Andercore

Andercore is the AI-native supplier of industrial materials for energy, infrastructure, and construction in wholesale and beyond.

We trade with global suppliers and distribute to European customers on our own account. Our AI runs the full trade and distribution end-to-end: sourcing, quality, pricing, sales, logistics, and embedded financing. For the customer, it feels like buying from their preferred local supplier; for our partners, it is the most convenient and safe way to do business across borders. Behind it, our software and agentic AI do the heavy lifting that used to take an asset-intensive supply chain with four or five intermediaries and weeks of manual coordination.

Where we are today:

  • Strong triple-digit-million euro turnover

  • Seven European markets live

  • 80+ people across Berlin (HQ), offices in London, Mumbai, and Shanghai

$40M Series B just closed, $75M raised to date from Atomico, Project A, and Inven Capital, institutional financing from international banks.

We are building the world's first and last industrial-grade AI operating system for materials, redefining how global trade works in one of the largest and most essential industries on earth.

What You Will Do

  • Identify, engage, and acquire suppliers across Europe and worldwide.

  • Lead negotiations for pricing, payment terms, and contracts of €1M+ procurement spend.

  • Build strong commercial relationships that fuel company growth and ensure reliable supply.

  • Develop and execute strategic plans to drive operational growth and efficiency, aligning with the company's global objectives.

  • Collaborate with Sales and operational teams to solve issues and improve operational processes that leverage automation and data.

  • Analyze performance data, track key KPIs, and deliver actionable insights to optimize end-to-end supply chain operations.

  • Analyze market trends, supplier capabilities, and pricing structures, and adjust strategy accordingly.

  • Identify cost-saving opportunities and drive continuous improvement initiatives.

  • Support long-term sourcing plans and risk mitigation strategies.

  • Resolve supplier-related issues, including quality, delivery, or compliance concerns.

Who You Are

  • You are experienced in procurement sourcing and supply chain contracting, and eager to take on responsibility in a fast-scaling, tech-driven environment.

  • You have strong analytical and negotiation skills, and can clearly articulate complex subjects with confidence and precision.

  • You bring a hands-on mentality — you take ownership, solve problems independently, and thrive in dynamic settings.

  • You are motivated by technology-driven transformation and curious about how AI can reshape global supply chains.

  • French or/and Italian Fluently and strong verbal and written communication skills in English.

What's In It for You

  • Real ownership from day one — shape operational processes in a fast-scaling, AI-first company.

  • Learn from the best — work directly with senior operators.

  • Competitive compensation — attractive base salary and performance-based bonus program.

  • Personal growth & visibility — rapid learning opportunities, cross-functional exposure, and early leadership potential in a growing global team.

  • Vibrant company culture — modern Berlin office, monthly All-Hands, team events, and regular offsites.

Why Join Us!

You'll be joining a company that's not only transforming a global industry but doing so with the speed, precision, and intelligence of AI. Here, you won't just manage supply chains — you'll help redefine how global commerce operates.

We are an equal-opportunity employer and welcome applicants from all backgrounds, regardless of race, ethnicity, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, age, disability, or any other characteristic. We believe that diversity drives innovation, creativity, and collective strength.

Compensation: €70K – €90K

  • • Yearly On Target Earnings (Fixed+ Bonus) €70K – €90K

title: Senior Finance Manager (f/m/x)
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Lemon Markets
description_html:
About lemon.markets 🍋

We enable anyone to be an investor. Our mission is to grow investing opportunities for all European customers and businesses. By empowering FinTechs, banks, and wealth managers to offer investment products, we help create financial well-being for their customers.

lemon.markets is a Brokerage-as-a-Service platform: simple digital access to capital markets through a single API. Our API-first infrastructure abstracts brokerage complexity with a well-documented API, a self-service customer operations portal, and a clear regulatory framework, so partners can launch customer-centric, compliant products in weeks, not months.

As part of the dwpbank Group, we share a clear goal: we enable anyone to be an investor by making investing in capital markets more accessible. By combining dwpbank’s long-standing expertise and stability with lemon.markets’ technology-first mindset and speed, we are building a modern, modular securities services ecosystem. Together, we offer faster time-to-market, modular services, and a modern customer experience that helps financial service providers stay competitive and respond more flexibly in a changing market.

Your Mission

Your mission is to be an integral part of building and scaling the Finance function within lemon.markets. As Senior Finance Manager you develop processes and policies as well as support the Product Development team and other functions - becoming the go-to person for external stakeholders and auditors. You will play an important role in establishing lemon.markets as the go-to-provider for launching investment products in Europe.

At lemon.markets we value ownership a lot. Meaning you have a lot of autonomy in shaping your area of responsibility. Your report directly to our VP of Finance and collaborating closely with Risk Management, Product, Compliance, among others, making sure our Finance function is set up for long-term operational excellence and scalability. This is your opportunity to have an impact, not just on the Finance department, but also on the product, to help launch a compliant investment product.

 

You will:

  • Manage and optimize various Finance processes, especially within Accounting, but also Regulatory Reporting or Planning and Controlling, by leveraging your knowledge and expertise.

  • Collaborate closely with the VP of Finance on special and strategic projects, helping transition processes into scalable, best-in-class workflows.

  • Be a point of contact for our external auditors, ensuring timely delivery of high quality documentation by various teams.

  • Work together closely with the Management Team and build, monitor and refine our annual financial plan and timelines.

  • Support on product work, defining and documenting functional requirements, establishing test concepts and testing/documentation and associated implications.

  • Cultivate a culture of knowledge-sharing as you work closely with our Product Development team, bridging the gap between finance and innovation for strategic product advancements.

 

You will be successful in this role if:

  • You have a strong background in Finance and regulated financial services. You have at least five years of experience in a finance function at a bank, FinTech, or another regulated institution, or with a Big Four or other leading audit firm. You have strong knowledge of German GAAP under HGB, including RechKredV or RechVersV. Knowledge of IFRS is a plus, as is experience with group accounting and consolidation.

  • You are proficient in Excel. You are comfortable using Excel to analyse financial information, prepare reports, and support finance processes. Experience with financial modelling is a plus.

  • You understand regulated financial environments. Experience in the regulated finance industry is required, and exposure to regulatory frameworks such as IFR or CRR would be particularly valuable.

  • You are willing to support in shaping the function. You are a hands-on player, willing to put high-quality processes in place from the beginning while remaining pragmatic with more complex solutions.

  • You thrive on ownership. You are intrinsically motivated to deliver value by taking initiative and challenging the status quo.

  • Communication and collaboration come naturally to you. You are able to communicate well with diverse audiences and explain requirements and technical topics clearly, while effectively communicating the risks and opportunities you identify.

  • You understand what working in a startup or similar lean organisation is like. You can move quickly and focus on what is truly important.

  • Growing investing opportunities excites you. Our mission resonates with you because you have worked in the financial sector, such as brokerage or banking, or in the technology sector, such as FinTech or API-first companies.

  • You are fluent in German, or comfortable working in a German-speaking regulatory environment. Fluency in German is a plus.

How we take care of you:

  • 🚀 Compensation package: We offer you a competitive salary, based on your experience and the value-add you bring to lemon.markets.

  • 🕑 Flexible working hours: We trust people to choose when they work best and avoid a rigid 9 to 5 mindset. You decide on the rhythm that helps you do your best work, with only shared core hours from 12:00 to 16:00 to support collaboration.

  • 🏢 Hybrid work setup: You can work from anywhere in Germany within a hybrid model. At the same time, in-person collaboration is a key part of our culture. That being said, individual contributer lemoneers work 4 days or more per month on-site in our Berlin office, spending quality time together with the team at events, onsites/offsites or over team dinners.

  • 📈 Grow with us: We take your personal development seriously! You’ll get regular mentorship and stretch opportunities, a clear career development framework with frequent feedback conversations as well as an annual learning budget.

  • 🌱 People & culture: You’ll feel our culture in the small things, like Polaroids from our lemoneers’ first day and our monthly new-joiner breakfasts. But also in the bigger things, like celebrating the onboarding of new partners or our annual offsites, where the whole company comes together to connect, reflect, and celebrate.

  • 💛 Perks & benefits: We choose benefits that add actual value. We sponsor a Deutschlandticket for employees on unlimited contracts, plus 50% off on Beatvest - our partner for financial education and investing.

  • 🏝 Workation: Get out of here! At lemon.markets you can work remotely from anywhere in the EU for up to 10 consecutive days at a time, and up to 60 days per year in total.

As an equal opportunity employer, lemon.markets is committed to building an inclusive workplace. The company welcomes people from all different backgrounds, including age, citizenship, ethnic and racial origins, gender identities, individuals with disabilities, marital status, religions and ideologies, and sexual orientations to apply.

If you feel this role could be a great match for you even if you don’t tick every box, we’d still love to hear from you, please apply.

You have any questions? Feel free to contact us via

title: Cryogenics Engineer (f/m/d)
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Focused
description_html:
Company Overview

 

Focused Energy is the leading laser-driven fusion company, dedicated to creating clean, limitless fusion power. We unite top scientific and engineering talent to unlock commercially viable fusion energy using proven technologies. Our goal is to drive economic growth and scientific innovation through the adoption of clean, abundant fusion energy worldwide.

 

Your Role

 

As a Cryogenics Engineer (f/m/d), you will play a pivotal role in designing, modeling, and optimizing advanced cryogenic thermal and fluid systems for commercial-scale fusion energy solutions. You will collaborate with interdisciplinary teams to develop, simulate, and validate experimental designs, helping define the roadmap toward efficient and scalable clean energy.

 

What You’ll Do

 

  • Own the end-to-end simulation and analysis function for cryogenic thermal and fluid systems—from problem definition through model development, validation, and continuous improvement.

  • Lead analytical approaches for new and undefined challenges, applying first-principles research to create pioneering solutions.

  • Drive model validation through close collaboration with experimental engineers, comparing simulation outputs to test data, and closing performance gaps.

  • Ensure that the Cryo team’s hardware decisions are consistently supported by robust quantitative analysis.

  • Develop integrated thermal and fluid analysis packages for commercial-scale system development, conducting optimization and sensitivity studies as needed.

  • Continuously refine analysis models as new experimental, materials, and system data become available.

  • Partner closely with hardware engineers, experimentalists, and scientists to define system requirements and deliver actionable analyses for design.

  • Provide the analytical foundation for the Cryo team’s technical roadmap, guiding what gets built, tested, and scaled.

 

Who You Are

 

  • 3–5 years’ experience (or equivalent PhD research) in integrated thermal and fluid analysis involving cryogenic systems (experience with hydrogen is preferred).

  • MSc or PhD in Mechanical Engineering, Physics, Chemical Engineering, or a related discipline.

  • Strong foundation in heat transfer, thermodynamics, and fluid mechanics.

  • Proficient in thermal analysis software (e.g., Thermal Desktop, COMSOL) and able to anchor analyses to real hardware.

  • Familiarity with hydrogen systems, vacuum systems, cryogenic technologies, and phase change in solids, liquids, and gases.

  • Skilled with instrumentation, sensors, and control logic for temperature, pressure, and flow in cryogenic environments.

  • Hands-on experience with test rig construction, system debugging, and low-temperature measurements to support model validation is a plus.

  • Comfortable collaborating across disciplines, and able to coordinate effectively with multiple engineering and science teams.

 

If you are excited about advancing clean energy and eager to make impact on a groundbreaking technology, we encourage you to apply.


Focused Energy is an equal opportunity employer committed to creating an inclusive environment. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender perception or identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, or disability status.

Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, Focused Energy will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

Compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, level, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Certain roles may be eligible for incentive compensation, equity, benefits.

Du hast Lust auf ein Praktikum, bei dem du dich für den Klimaschutz einsetzen kannst? Du möchtest gerne in die Fundraising-Abteilung einer gemeinnützigen Organisation reinschnuppern, hast Spaß daran, komplexe Themen rund um Klima und Politik zielgruppengerecht aufzubereiten und hast Lust, die wichtigste Kampagnen-Saison mitzubegleiten? Super! Dann bewirb dich als Praktikant:in für unser Fundraising-Team mit dem Schwerpunkt Stiftungs- & Kleinspendenfundraising! Wir suchen eine:n neue:n Praktikant:in ab 1. September oder 1. Oktober 2026.

Mögliche Aufgaben: 

  • Recherche von neuen Stiftungen und Fördermittelgeber:innen: Du identifizierst neue Trends sowie potenzielle Stiftungen, Aufrufe und Ausschreibungen, die zu unseren Projekten und strategischen Zielen passen, und erstellst Übersichten zu deren Förderkriterien und -schwerpunkten. 

  • Kampagnen-Planung & Umsetzung: Du unterstützt bei der inhaltlichen und gestalterischen Umsetzung für Fundraising-Kampagnen, vom ersten Konzept bis zur Ausspielung über Mail oder Social-Media – insbesondere unsere Weihnachtskampagne 

  • Mitwirkung an Kommunikationsmaßnahmen & Spendenaktionen: Du unterstützt bei der Erstellung von Quartalsupdates, Rundmails, Spendenmailings, Förder-Aufrufen und besonderen Aktionen, die unsere Unterstützer:innen und potenzielle Fördermittelgeber:innen erreichen. 

  • Erstellen von Präsentationen und Projektvorstellungen: Du unterstützt bei der Konzeption und Gestaltung von überzeugenden Präsentationen, um Stiftungen und Fördermittelgeber:innen für unsere Projekte zu gewinnen. 

  • Unterstützung bei der Redaktion von Anträgen: Du hilfst bei der Erstellung und Überarbeitung von Förderanträgen, Zwischen- und Endberichten sowie der Dokumentation von Erfolgen und erzielter Wirkung. 

  • Rundum-Blick in die digitalen Werkzeuge im Fundraising: Du erhältst Einblicke in die Nutzung von CRM-Systemen, KI-Tools & Datenbanken sowie Werkzeugen zur Projektsteuerung und zum Controlling großer Projektvorhaben. 

  • Weitere Themen: Wenn du Lust hast, in weitere Fundraising-Themen reinzuschnuppern, hast du in unserem agilen Team jederzeit die Möglichkeit dazu. Wir erstellen einen umfassenden Praktikumsplan, der perfekt auf dich passt! 


  • Du bist kommunikationsfreudig, kannst gut zuhören und gehst offen auf andere Menschen zu.  

  • Du bist strukturiert und arbeitest selbstständig, erkennst aber auch deine Grenzen und scheust dich nicht, rechtzeitig nach Unterstützung oder Feedback zu fragen.  

  • Du bist sicher im Erstellen von Texten, hast ein gutes Auge fürs Detail und ein feines Gespür für ansprechende Kommunikation. 

  • Du bist eine gute Teamplayer:in, behältst deine Aufgaben gut im Blick und bringst Interesse an digitalen Tools und Software-Lösungen mit. 

  • Dir liegt der Klimaschutz am Herzen, und du möchtest andere Menschen für das Thema begeistern und gemeinsam etwas bewegen  

  • Du willst zeigen, wie wichtig das Engagement durch Spenden und Fördermittel für gemeinnützige Organisationen ist. 

Wichtig: Wir können aktuell leider nur Pflichtpraktika im Rahmen eines Studiums oder ein freiwilliges Engagement auf ehrenamtlicher Basis anbieten. Das Praktikum ist nicht vergütet. Wir arbeiten daran, zukünftig Praktikant:innen zumindest eine Aufwandsentschädigung bezahlen zu können. Sobald das eine Option ist, werden wir diesen Text hier anpassen.

Remote-Arbeit ist möglich. Idealerweise suchen wir für diese Stelle eine Person, die in Berlin lebt und regelmäßig vor Ort sein kann. Wir suchen Praktikant:innen für einen Zeitraum von mindestens 3 Monaten mit 20-30 Stunden die Woche.

Haben wir dich neugierig gemacht? Dann komm in unser Team und arbeite gemeinsam mit uns am Ziel, das Pariser Klimaversprechen einzuhalten und Deutschland mit konkreten Lösungen klimaneutral zu machen!  

Bitte sende uns einen Lebenslauf und ein Anschreiben zu, aus dem deine Motivation deutlich wird.

Aktuell suchen wir für einen unserer Kunden einen Senior System Engineer (m/w/d).

  • Projektstandort: Bonn/Nürnberg

  • Zeitraum: 17. Oktober 2026 bis 31. Dezember 2026

  • Arbeitsmix: 40 Tage Remote/ 5 Tage vor Ort

  • Wichtig: Remote-Arbeit nur in Deutschland möglich

  • Wichtig: Projektsprache in deutsch

  • Weiterentwicklung der Best-of-Breed Eigenentwicklung zur Firewall Automatisierung (FWAT)

  • FWAT soll die Verwaltung (Beantragung, Revalidierung, Löschen) von Firewall-Regeln automatisieren. Dazu sollen entsprechende Benutzer-

  • Die Ablage der Firewall-Regel soll für eine automatischen Deployment in der Cloud in einem Repository abgelegt werden. Zusätzlichen sollen Algorithmen bzw. Aufbereitung der Topologien als visuelle Darstellung für eine Optimierung genutzt werden. Dabei darf der Bezug zum Antragssteller nicht verloren geht

  • mindestens 2 Jahre in Python / FastAPI - Projektreferenz erforderlich

  • mindestens 2 Jahre Erfahrung mit mermaid - Projektreferenz erforderlich

title: Logistiker im Bereich Maintenance / Service (w/m/d)
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at encontec GmbH
description_html:
Wir wachsen weiter und suchen Dich zur Verstärkung unseres Instandhaltungsteams am Standort in Oberkochen als:

Logistiker im Bereich Maintenance / Service (w/m/d)


Unser Instandhaltungsteam am Standort in Oberkochen, stellt die Verfügbarkeit der Maschinen und Anlagen in Hightech-Produktionsbereichen sicher und bei Ausfällen den funktionsfähigen Zustand wieder her. Das Leistungsspektrum umfasst die gesamten elektrischen/elektronischen Instandhaltungsarbeiten, die in einem Maschinen- u. Anlagenpark anfallen. Wir planen und führen Maschinen- und Anlagenumzüge durch. Mit speziellen Geräten führen wir Mess- und Kalibrierarbeiten durch. Wir stellen die Anlagensicherheit durch Prüfung gemäß DGUV-V3 sicher. Das kontinuierlich wachsende Team setzt sich aktuell aus ca. 70 Mitarbeiterinnen und Mitarbeitern zusammen und arbeitet im Ein- und Mehrschichtbetrieb.

Dein zukünftiger Tätigkeitsbereich

  • Bedienung des zentralen automatisierten Lagersystems

  • Erstellung und Beantragung von SAP Nummern für Lager-Produkte

  • Optimierung und Strukturierung der Lagerwaren im Lagersystem

  • Durchführen von Ein- und Auslagerungen (SAP)

  • Bestandsüberwachung und Sicherstellung der Materialverfügbarkeit

  • Anlegen von nicht deklarierten Produkten/Materialien im Lagersystem

  • Aufnahme von neuen Materialien/Ersatzteilen im Lagersystem

  • Optimierung der Arbeitsabläufe und Prozesse

  • Beschaffung von Verpackungsmaterial

  • Wareneingangs- und Warenausgangsbuchungen (SAP)

  • Beantragung von Transporten und Gewährleistung des transportsicheren Versands

  • Zentrale Lagerverwaltung

Das zeichnet Dich aus

  • Du hast eine abgeschlossene Ausbildung Fachkraft für Lagerlogistik oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation

  • Berufserfahrung in der Auftragsbearbeitung im Logistik Bereich 

  • Du kennst die gängigen MS-Office-Programme

  • Du hast gute Kenntnisse mit SAP 

  • Du verfügst über sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und in Schrift 

Deine berufliche Zukunft

  • Vergütung: Bei uns erhältst Du ein attraktives Gehalt mit zusätzlichen Leistungszulagen wie Schichtzuschlägen sowie eine monatliche Erfolgsprämie.

  • Mitarbeiter-Benefits: Nutze unser Jobrad-Angebot und profitiere unter anderem von betrieblichen Zusatzleistungen wie Weihnachtsgeld, Urlaubsgeld, bezuschusste betriebliche Altersvorsorge und VWL.

  • Work-Life-Balance: Uns ist die Vereinbarkeit von Job und Familie sehr wichtig, daher sind 30 Tage Urlaub und ein Gleitzeitkonto selbstverständlich.

  • Wachsendes Unternehmen: Unterstütze uns auf unserem Expansionskurs. Dafür erhältst Du einen sicheren, unbefristeten und krisenfesten Arbeitsplatz.

  • Arbeitsplatz: Du arbeitest bei uns am Standort in Oberkochen, es gibt keine täglichen Dienstreisen.

  • Professionelle Einarbeitung: Für einen guten Start in den Job, bekommst Du von uns eine intensive Einarbeitung. Erfahrene Kolleginnen und Kollegen stehen Dir zur Seite.

  • Kollegiales Arbeitsklima: Dich erwartet ein tolles, wertschätzendes Betriebsklima. Transparenz und offene Kommunikation sind uns wichtig, damit Du dich bei uns wohlfühlst.

  • Arbeitssicherheit: Deine Sicherheit steht bei uns an erster Stelle, daher legen wir viel Wert auf Gesundheitsschutz und einen sicheren Arbeitsplatz. Jede Mitarbeiterin und Mitarbeiter erhält funktionale Arbeitsbekleidung.

  • Ausstattung: Unsere Mitarbeiterinnen und Mitarbeiter sind mit professionellem Werkzeug ausgestattet.

  • Firmenveranstaltungen und Mitarbeiterevents: Freu Dich auf das traditionelle jährliche Standortfest, die Team-Weihnachtsfeier und tolle Teamevents.

description_html:
Für unser Team und Unternehmen in Köln suchen wir einen Trainee Online-Marketing-Manager/-in - Vollzeit (m/w/d), welche uns bei unseren Kundenprojekten unterstützt.


Suchst du den professionellen Einstieg ins Online-Marketing? Du willst der/die Beste im Online-Marketing sein? 

Als Trainee Online-Marketing-Manager/-in - Vollzeit (m/w/d) arbeitest du sehr intensiv mit unseren Kunden zusammen und verwaltest deren Werbekampagnen. Nach einer ausführlichen Einarbeitung bist du ein Experte für Online Marketing / Performance-Marketing und somit auch gleichzeitig direkter Ansprechpartner für unsere Kunden zu Themen wie Meta-Ads, Google-Ad's, TikTok- Ads, Funnelarchitektur, Online-Sichtbarkeit, langfristiges Branding und vielen Weiteren.


Deine Aufgaben: 

  • Konzipiere, optimiere und verwalte Werbekampagnen unserer Kunden

  • Konzipiere, optimiere und verwalte Werbekampagnen für uns intern

  • Betreue individuell unterschiedlichste Brands in der Pflege

  • Verwalte bis zu 6-stellige Werbebudgets

  • Arbeite eng mit unserem Video-Team zusammen um die kreativsten Video- & Image-Ads geliefert zu bekommen

  • Erstellst Reportings und Analysen der bestehenden Werbekampagnen unserer Kunden

  • Optimierung bestehender Strategien durch gezielten Einsatz unseres Know-How's

  • Enge Zusammenarbeit mit unseren Kunden

  • Erfolgskontrolle  der Werbekampagnen und regelmäßiger Feedback


Für uns ist es wichtig, dass jeder Mitarbeiter die Chance erhält, sein Potenzial zu entfalten und sich selbst zu verwirklichen. Unbefristete Stellen, höhenverstellbare Tische, neue Apple Geräte, modernes Office, Boni und Gutscheine sowie jeden Tag frisches Obst sind bei uns selbstverständlich.
Wir sind ein etabliertes Familienunternehmen und legen sehr viel Wert darauf, dass hier alle an einem Strang ziehen und wir alle in einer professionellen Atmosphäre arbeiten können.


Gehalt: 3.000 Euro pro Monat (brutto)

Weiterentwicklungs- und Aufstiegsmöglichkeiten in den nächsten Jahren sind vorhanden.


Was wir bieten:

  • Strukturierte Einarbeitung: Wir bringen dir alle vertrieblichen Fähigkeiten bei, um bei uns Erfolg zu haben.

  • Modernes Büro im Zentrum von Köln: Modernste Büroausstattungen für deine tägliche Arbeit

  • Sicherer Arbeitsplatz: Unser kontinuierliches Wachstum bietet dir langfristige Perspektiven und Arbeitsplatzsicherheit.

  • Kollegiale Arbeitsatmosphäre: Arbeite in einem kollegialen und unterstützenden Team, das zusammenhält.

  • Attraktive Vergütung & Karrierechancen: Starte mit einem attraktiven Gehalt von 3.000 Euro brutto monatlich und freue dich auf Weiterentwicklungsmöglichkeiten in den nächsten Jahren.


Das solltest Du mitbringen:

  • Eine abgeschlossene Ausbildung ist hilfreich, aber nicht erforderlich

  • Die Fähigkeit, bestehenden Prozessen zu folgen

  • Schnelle Auffassungsgabe und hohe Disziplin

  • Starke kommunikative Fähigkeiten und ein großes empathisches Gespür

  • Guter Umgang mit Leistungsdruck

  • Ausgeprägte Teamfähigkeit

  • Saubere und fehlerfreie schriftliche Ausdrucksform in Deutsch

  • Vorkenntnisse in den Themen Online-Marketing, Agentur, Coaching, Beratung etc. sind von Vorteil, aber nicht notwendig

Du bist neugierig? Dann bewirb dich bei uns!

title: Teamleiter für Haushaltshilfen (m/w/d) – Quereinsteiger willkommen!
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Agentur für Haushaltshilfe GmbH
description_html:
Agentur für Haushaltshilfe

Die Nr. 1 für professionelle Haushaltshilfe und Alltagsbegleitung in Deutschland.

Unser Ziel ist es, dafür zu sorgen, dass hilfsbedürftige Menschen da leben können, wo sie sich am wohlsten fühlen – und das ist in ihrem eigenen Zuhause. Seit 2018 sind wir binnen 8 Jahren zum führenden Anbieter für Haushaltshilfe und Alltagsbegleitung in Deutschland gewachsen. Mit mehr als 13.600 Mitarbeitern betreuen wir deutschlandweit über 110.000 Kunden. Du möchtest etwas Sinnvolles tun? Dann bist du bei uns genau richtig!

Unser Spirit

  • Wir haben Teamgeist und wissen, dass man die besten Ergebnisse gemeinsam erzielt

  • Wir bauen auf Wertschätzung, Respekt, Motivation, Vertrauen & Verantwortung

  • Wir kommunizieren offen, ehrlich & fair

  • Wir machen Fehler, doch wir lernen daraus

  • Wir fördern individuelle Talente

  • Wir sind interkulturell

Das bieten wir dir

  • Flexible (familienfreundliche) Arbeitszeiten – Montag-Freitag, Vollzeit oder Teilzeit (min. 30 Std./Woche)

  • Eigenständiges Arbeiten – mit unbefristeter Festanstellung in einer Branche mit Zukunft

  • Individuelle Schulungen und Begleitung durch unsere Teamkoordinatoren

  • Corporate Benefits – Mitarbeiterrabatte mit exklusiven Vergünstigungen

  • Moderne Arbeitsmittel – Diensthandy & Laptop

  • Team-Events – wie Sommerfest und Weihnachtsfeier

Nach der Probezeit:

  • Betriebliche Krankenzusatzversicherung – Gesundheitsbudget von 600€ pro Jahr

  • Betriebliche Altersvorsorge – plus Arbeitgeberzuschuss

  • TOP Dienstwagen mit Tankkarte – zur vollen privaten Nutzung (nach bestimmten Kriterien)

  • Deutschlandticket als Jobticket (bezuschusst)

  • Jobbike


Deine Rolle

  • Du bist das Gesicht der Agentur für Haushaltshilfe in deiner Region

  • Marketing- und Vertriebsmaßnahmen – Aufbau deines eigenen Teams aus Haushaltshilfen und Kunden

  • Koordinierung deines Teams – Betreuung aller hilfsbedürftigen Kunden in deinem Bezirk sicherstellen

  • Ansprechpartner für deinen Bezirk – du vertrittst deinen Bezirk bei allen Anliegen und Entscheidungen gegenüber der Zentrale

Selbstverständlich bist du nicht allein. Unser Team in der Zentrale hält dir den Rücken frei und unterstützt dich tatkräftig beim Ausbau deines Bezirks und beim Führen deines Teams.

Das bringst du mit

  • Eigenverantwortliches und selbstständiges Handeln

  • Kontaktfreudig, kommunikativ und schaffst gerne Verbindungen zwischen Menschen

  • Sorgfältige, nachhaltige und gründliche Arbeitsweise

  • Stehst gern im Mittelpunkt und machst dich in deiner Region bekannt

  • Du möchtest dich beruflich umorientieren? Werde Teil des Teams, Quereinsteiger sind bei uns willkommen!

  • Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift (mindestens C1)

Jetzt bewerben und Leben verändern!

description_html:
Agentur für Haushaltshilfe

Die Nr. 1 für professionelle Haushaltshilfe und Alltagsbegleitung in Deutschland.

Leite dein Team, gestalte deinen Tag, behalte deine Freiheit.

Du bist Pflegefachkraft und willst nicht mehr pflegen, sondern führen, organisieren und strategisch wirken? Bei uns übernimmst du die Teamleitung, koordinierst Einsätze, klärst Kunden über unsere Dienstleistungen auf und baust Netzwerke mit Kooperationspartnern auf – alles ohne Schichtstress und mit flexiblen Arbeitszeiten.

Seit 2018 sind wir binnen 8 Jahren zum führenden Anbieter für Haushaltshilfe und Alltagsbegleitung in Deutschland gewachsen. Mit mehr als 13.600 Mitarbeitern betreuen wir deutschlandweit über 110.000 Kunden.

Als Teamleitung bei der Agentur für Haushaltshilfe profitierst du von einer entspannten Arbeitsumgebung ohne Unterbesetzung oder körperliche Dauerbelastung und hast die Freiheit, eigenständig zu arbeiten. Statt Stress und Überforderung steht hier der Mensch im Mittelpunkt – mit ausreichend Zeit für eine persönliche Betreuung. Steige bei uns ein und gestalte deinen Berufsalltag nach deinen Vorstellungen – mit Sinn, Flexibilität und Wertschätzung!

Unser Spirit

  • Wir bauen auf Wertschätzung, Respekt, Motivation, Vertrauen & Verantwortung

Das bieten wir dir

  • Flexible (familienfreundliche) Arbeitszeiten – Montag-Freitag, Vollzeit oder Teilzeit (min. 30 Std./Woche)

  • Quereinstieg aus der Pflege möglich – nutze deine Erfahrung in einer neuen Rolle

  • Individuelle Schulungen und Begleitung durch unsere Teamkoordinatoren

  • Corporate Benefits – Mitarbeiterrabatte mit exklusiven Vergünstigungen

  • Moderne Arbeitsmittel – Diensthandy & Laptop

  • Team-Events – wie Sommerfest und Weihnachtsfeier

Nach der Probezeit:

  • Betriebliche Krankenzusatzversicherung – Gesundheitsbudget von 600€ pro Jahr

  • Betriebliche Altersvorsorge – plus Arbeitgeberzuschuss

  • Deutschlandticket als Jobticket (bezuschusst)

  • Jobbike


Warum diese Rolle anders ist

  • Sei dein eigener Chef – gestalte dein Team, baue Netzwerke und bringe unsere Dienstleistungen aktiv zu den Kunden

  • Netzwerken & Aufklären – stelle unseren Kunden unsere Dienstleistungen vor, baue Kontakte zu Kooperationspartnern auf

  • Führung statt Pflege – koordiniere dein regionales Team von Haushaltshilfen, motiviere deine Mitarbeitenden und gestalte Prozesse

  • Selbstbestimmt arbeiten – du planst deinen Arbeitstag nach deinen Vorstellungen, nicht nach einem Schichtplan

  • Mehr Zeit für Qualität – weniger Hektik, mehr Fokus auf echte Betreuung und Teamführung

Selbstverständlich bist du nicht allein. Unser Team in der Zentrale hält dir den Rücken frei und unterstützt dich tatkräftig beim Ausbau deines Bezirks und beim Führen deines Teams.

Das bringst du mit

  • Ausbildung als Pflegefachkraft (z. B. Psychologe/in, Sozialpädagoge, Diplompädagoge/in, Heilpädagoge, Pflegefachfrau/mann, Gesundheitspfleger/in, Krankenpfleger/in, Altenpfleger/in, Kinderkrankenpfleger/in, Heilerziehungspfleger/in, Erzieher/in, Hauswirtschafter/in, Hauswirtschaftliche Betriebsleiter/in, Meister der Hauswirtschaft)

  • Kontaktfreudig, kommunikativ und schaffst gerne Verbindungen zwischen Menschen

  • Sorgfältige, nachhaltige und gründliche Arbeitsweise

  • Stehst gern im Mittelpunkt und machst dich in deiner Region bekannt

  • Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift (mindestens C1)

Du willst mehr Verantwortung, Führung und Gestaltungsspielraum – ohne den Dauerstress der klassischen Pflege?

Bei uns leitest du dein Team, baust Netzwerke auf, klärst Kunden auf und arbeitest selbstbestimmt, flexibel und familienfreundlich.

title: Expansion Manager, EU Airport transfers (all genders)
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Distribusion Technologies
description_html:
About us

Distribusion is the world’s leading ground transportation marketplace and gives travelers seamless access to ground transportation online, from search to ticket purchase. We have built a cutting-edge B2B technology platform that connects bus, rail, and ferry operators in 70+ countries with the biggest online retailers, including Google Maps and Booking.com.

We are shaping the future of travel and building the largest global network of transport providers and retailers. We are one of the fastest-growing startups in travel, backed by leading venture capital investors including TQ Ventures, Lightrock, Creandum, and Northzone, and are headquartered in Berlin, Germany. Following our recent $80m Series C funding, we are ready to push beyond.

The Opportunity

We are looking for an entrepreneurial Expansion Manager to focus on market expansion and build and scale Distribusion’s airport transfer operator network across Europe. This is a high-ownership role for someone who wants to build a business within a company. Working within Distribusion’s broader airport commercial strategy, you will own a clearly defined sub-segment end to end - from identifying attractive markets and securing operator partnerships to launching them and delivering measurable commercial growth.
You will have the opportunity to build the approach from scratch, deliver highly visible results and take on broader responsibility as the segment scales.


What you will do

  • Translate the broader airport strategy into a prioritised expansion plan, based on market potential, coverage gaps and clear business cases

  • Build a repeatable market-entry playbook, incorporating market feedback and lessons from execution

  • Originate, negotiate and close partnerships with airport transfer operators, supported by compelling and tailored commercial propositions

  • Build senior relationships with operators, airports, airport authorities and relevant local partners to unlock market access and growth

  • Coordinate internal teams through contracting, integration, launch and ramp-up

  • Own post-launch commercial performance, identify gaps and drive corrective actions

Workplace: Berlin & Hybrid or Europe & Remote


Who you are:

  • You bring 2-3 years at a top-tier consulting firm, or 3-5 years in sales, business development, or a commercial role at a high-growth tech company.

  • You have a track record of taking ownership of a commercial area and growing it: markets deepened, strategies sharpened, results delivered

  • You can navigate product complexity and translate it into a compelling sales narrative; experience as a tech BD or sales engineer with full commercial cycle ownership is a strong signal

  • Experience in a tech company, marketplace, or platform business is a strong advantage; B2B sales experience is a plus

  • A background in consulting, or experience at a high-growth tech platform or fast-scaling startup, tells us a lot about your operating style

  • You are self-driven, independent, and resourceful; you thrive with full ownership and minimal guidance

  • You collaborate well in a matrixed environment and bring positive ambition to teams where others are also running their own markets

  • Excellent negotiation, communication, and interpersonal skills

  • You are fluent in English (spoken and written); an additional European language, French, German, or others, is a big plus

What you can expect:

  • Make a global impact. Help shape how millions of people discover and book ground transportation worldwide.

  • Own your work. Take responsibility from day one and see the direct impact of your contributions.

  • Build with the best tools. We move fast, continuously evolve our tech stack, and invest in modern, efficient solutions.

  • Work with industry leaders. Our partners include Booking.com, Google Maps, Amtrak, Deutsche Bahn, Renfe, and SNCF.

  • Grow with exceptional people. Join an international team that will challenge, support, and inspire you every day.

  • Work your way. Enjoy flexible and remote-friendly working options, relocation opportunities, and plenty of room to grow.


Our hiring process for this role:
For any queries, please reach out to your Talent Partner, Limor Ziv, at How we hire

title: Senior Tech Operations Specialist (all genders)

description_html:
About us

Distribusion is the world’s leading ground transportation marketplace and gives travellers seamless access to ground transportation online, from search to ticket purchase. We have built a cutting-edge B2B technology platform that connects bus, rail and ferry operators in 70+ countries with the biggest online retailers including Google Maps and Booking.com.
We are shaping the future of travel and building the largest global network of transport providers and retailers. We are one of the fastest-growing startups in travel, backed by two leading VCs (TQ Ventures & Lightrock), and now, following our recent $80m Series C funding, we are ready to push beyond.

The Opportunity

We are looking for a Senior Technical Operations Specialist who will join our Control Room team. You will play a vital role in managing ongoing escalations and investigations, ensuring seamless communication with our partners and management during issue resolution, conceptualising new operational flows and guaranteeing the seamless operation of all company products.

What you will do:

  • Operational Ownership: Take full ownership of high-level monitoring for the company’s operations, ensuring smooth and efficient processes across the business.

  • Incident Management & Resolution: Lead the management of escalations and incidents, driving swift resolutions and minimizing impact on business operations.

  • Problem-Solving & Innovation: Conduct in-depth technical investigations and collaborate in designing solutions that address complex challenges and improve system performance.

  • Data-Driven Insights: Leverage data analysis to validate hypotheses, uncover insights, and identify optimisation opportunities that drive operational excellence and incident prevention.

  • Strategic Project Leadership: Play a pivotal role in supporting and leading strategic and operational projects that shape the direction and efficiency of the business.

  • Continuous Improvement: Proactively identify and implement key improvements in our product and tech systems from an operational perspective, making a tangible impact on performance.

  • Tool & Process Development: Work closely with the operations team to build, implement, and refine tools and processes that drive efficiency and streamline workflows, leveraging AI to help us scale as we grow.

  • Effective Communication: Manage internal and external communication effectively, collaborating across teams to ensure seamless issue resolution and clear, transparent updates.


Workplace: Berlin, hybrid or Germany, remote


Who you are:

  • You bring at least 3+ years of experience in similar roles in 2nd and 3rd level Technical support, IT Analyst, Monitoring roles etc. 

  • You are able to successfully detect root cause of incidents reported and provide analysis of the solution design on a high level

  • You bring a product-oriented mindset: You do not focus on the immediate solution only, but you are bringing long-term risk prevention and mitigation strategies

  • You feel comfortable with investigating into complex SQL queries and relational databases

  • You can develop strategies to predict, prevent, and address potential technical and operational bottlenecks and inefficiencies

  • As a big plus, you have already worked with Jira and Prometheus, Grafana, New Relic or other monitoring tools

  • You are able to collaborate with cross-functional teams to diagnose and resolve incoming technical issues, ensuring minimal disruptions to business operations

  • Your English is fluent, and you are able to unravel complexity in a simple and understandable manner

  • You are analytical, independent and tech-savvy

  • You are comfortable with fast-paced environments and heavy context switching

A view into our Tech stack:

  • Tracking and analytics: Prometheus, Grafana, New Relic, BigQuery

  • Database: PostgreSQL

  • Project management: Jira

Your Talent Partner (TP) and point of contact is Anh Do, and the Hiring Manager (HM) is Ygor Alvarez.

title: Public Affairs Manager - digitale Bildung (gn)
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at sofatutor GmbH
description_html:
sofatutor ist eine digitale Lernplattform für fast 2 Millionen Kinder, Schüler*innen, Eltern und Lehrkräfte. Als Public Affairs Manager gestaltest du die Bildungspolitik in Deutschland aktiv mit: Du vertrittst sofatutor in der Politik, vernetzt dich mit Ministerien, Ländern und Verbänden und treibst digitale Bildung voran. Gemeinsam mit dem Director Schools bewegst du dich sicher in den Schaltzentren der Bildungspolitik – von Kultusministerien bis zu kommunalen Schulträgern.

📍 remote innerhalb Deutschlands | ⏳ 40 h / Woche

Dein Verantwortungsbereich:

  • Netzwerkarbeit: Aufbau von Beziehungen zu Politik, Ministerien, Schulträgern – insbesondere in den Bundesländern.

  • Repräsentanz: Repräsentation von sofatutor auf Konferenzen, Messen, öffentlichen Veranstaltungen und in Ausschüssen.

  • Monitoring und Strategieentwicklung: Überwachung regulatorischer Entwicklungen sowie Erstellung strategischer Handlungsempfehlungen für unser Team und unsere Organisation.

  • Vertrieb & Verhandlung: Direktvertrieb unserer Schulprodukte an Länder, Schulträger und kommunale Bildungseinrichtungen sowie erfolgreiche Verhandlung von Produktoptionen und Vertragsbedingungen.

  • Politische Kommunikation: Erstellung von Positionspapieren, Briefings und politischen Kommunikationsmaterialien.


Das bringst du mit:

  • Fundierte Erfahrung in Public Affairs, Government Relations, politischer Kommunikation oder einem vergleichbaren Umfeld – idealerweise mit Bezug zur (digitalen) Bildungsbranche.

  • Kenntnisse relevanter bildungspolitischer Institutionen und Prozesse (KMK, Bund, Bildungsministerien, Schulgesetze der Länder).

  • Sicheres Auftreten im Umgang mit politischen Entscheidungsträger*innen und öffentlichen Institutionen sowie Verständnis der dazugehörigen Entscheidungsprozesse.

  • Ausgeprägte Kommunikationsstärke und die Fähigkeit,  komplexe Sachverhalte für unterschiedliche Zielgruppen prägnant aufzubereiten. 

  • Freude am Netzwerken und Lust, sofatutor mit Vorträgen oder in Podiumsdiskussionen eine Stimme zu geben.

  • Reisebereitschaft innerhalb Deutschlands, um sofatutor regelmäßig auf Messen oder anderen Netzwerktreffen zu repräsentieren (ca. 1-2 Mal pro Monat).

  • Deutsch auf muttersprachlichem Niveau sowie gute Englischkenntnisse für die interne Kommunikation.


Das bieten wir dir:

  • 🕒 Flexibilität: flexiblen Arbeitszeiten, remote-first Arbeitsmodell, Arbeit aus dem EU-Ausland für 180 Tage / Jahr

  • 💻 Mobiles Arbeiten: Laptop, Headset, Monitor + 100 € Zuschuss für Equipment 

  • 🌍 Mobilität: Zuschuss zu ÖPNV-Tickets, Swapfiets Fahrräder

  • 🎉 Gemeinschaft: regelmäßige Team-Events, remote oder vor Ort in Berlin

  • 💚 Ehrenamt & freie Tage: Zwei freie Tage / Jahr für Ehrenamt + freie Tage an Heiligabend & Silvester

  • 💪🏻 Wohlbefinden: Urban Sports Club, Fitnessstudio-Mitgliedschaften, Zugang zu Bloom

  • 💸 Rabatte: FutureBens, Corporate Benefits, Rabatte auf sofatutor-Produkt

  • 💳 Flexible Zusatzleistungen: givve-Benefits-Kreditkarte

Wir bei sofatutor arbeiten jeden Tag daran, unser integratives Arbeitsumfeld so weiterzuentwickeln, dass deine Entwicklung unabhängig von Geschlecht, Familienstand, sexueller Orientierung, Religionszugehörigkeit, Alter, Behinderungsgrad, Bildungsstand oder Ethnie gefördert wird. Unterstütze uns gern dabei und schließe dich an!

Erlebe Consulting „live“ und profitiere vom Coaching durch erfahrene Kolleg:innen

  • Sehr gute Kenntnisse im Umgang mit MS Office, gerne ergänzt durch weitere Digital- / Tool-Kompetenz im jeweiligen Fachbereich.

  • Verhandlungssichere Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse, gute Kenntnisse der französischen Sprache sind von Vorteil.

  • Vielseitige Projekte bei Unternehmen unterschiedlichster Größen und Branchen sowie eigenständige und verantwortungsvolle Mitarbeit bei der Weiterentwicklung von enomyc

  • Individuelle Karrieremöglichkeiten sowie unterjährige Beförderungen bei exzellenten Leistungen

  • Mobile Working & Workation

  • Zahlreiche weitere Benefits (z.B. vielseitige Gesundheits- und Sportangebote sowie innovative und modern ausgestattete Bürostandorte)

  • Motivierendes Umfeld, ein eingeschworenes Team und abwechslungsreiche Teamevents

Jetzt Karriere bei enomyc starten

Deine Ansprechpartnerin für diese Position ist Anne Rienecker, Lead Talent Management & Sourcing Strategy. Bei Fragen ist sie gerne für Dich da – persönlich und auf Augenhöhe.

Gestalte mit uns die Zukunft des Mittelstands – und Deinen nächsten Karriereschritt.
